learning_outcomes.text: Students learn methods and technical expertise to manage design tasks for simple and moderately complex machines.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to important machine elements (e.g., shafts and rolling bearings)
Selection, design, and functional installation of machine components
Calculation methods for designing, dimensioning, and testing components for strength and service life
Systematic approach to solving complex technical problems
Design methodology based on VDI Guideline 2221 ff.
assessment_rules: The assessment is a graded written exam of 120 minutes duration. The performance contribution from Maschinenelemente 1 (MABB241) is weighted 2:1 relative to Konstruktionslehre 1 (MABB242) for the overall module grade.
bibliography: Wittel, H. et al.: Roloff/Matek Maschinenelemente – Normung, Berechnung, Gestaltung. Springer 2017
Pahl, G.; Beitz, W.: Konstruktionslehre – Methoden und Anwendung erfolgreicher Produktentwicklung. Springer 2013
